name: Camping 101: Cooking
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: This quest is new in Forever: its text, givers, objectives and rewards come from Wowhead’s Forever database until the beta confirms them. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, champion. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.
narrative.objectives: Speak with Cook Torka in Razor Hill to learn to become a cook.
narrative.offerRewardText: With this, you'll be able to set up a camp anywhere out in the wilderness. What you've learned is just the basics, so you won't be able to place too many furnishings around it.Raise your cooking skill and you might just be able to learn to make even bigger fires.You can also learn the basics of furnishing your campsites from other tradeskill trainers if you're savvy in their skills.
narrative.requestItemsText: A good campfire is the foundation to any good camp.
